notes: A sparse amendment, and the first real-world proof that the rulebook design works. Moldova raised the VAT registration threshold twice inside one year: to MDL 1.5m from 1 January 2026, then to MDL 1.7m from 1 March 2026. Rather than duplicating the whole year, this set carries ONLY the key that changed and overlaps md-2026 for the rest of the year. Because it was published later, it shadows md-2026 for dates both cover; every other key falls through to md-2026. A product that hardcoded the threshold would have had to ship a patch mid-year — twice.

sources.act: Codul fiscal al Republicii Moldova nr. 1163/1997, art. 112 alin. (1) si (4)

tax.vat.registration_threshold.note: Raised from MDL 1,500,000 to MDL 1,700,000 with effect from 1 March 2026. The original proposal was MDL 3.2m; a phased increase was chosen instead, constrained by EU Directive 2006/112/EC, which caps the exemption threshold at roughly EUR 85,000. Expect further increases, so never treat this number as settled.
